# AirLens

> AirLens is an air-quality intelligence platform. It combines satellite AOD
> (aerosol optical depth), ground-station measurements, and weather-model data
> into live PM2.5 estimates, forecasts, and causal policy analysis — always
> published with explicit uncertainty (p10–p90 intervals) and a DQSS
> data-quality grade (A–F). We call this the Glass-box principle: no bare
> point estimates, no hidden confidence.

Canonical origin: https://airlens.cloud
Locales: English (default, `/…`) and Korean (`/ko/…` — rolling out).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://airlens.cloud/): OBSERVATORY — a scroll-driven flight over live
  global PM2.5, wind advection, and fire detections.
- [Today](https://airlens.cloud/today): real-time PM2.5 at the visitor's
  coordinates with a p10-p90 uncertainty band, DQSS grade, weather, nearby
  pollutants and a 48h forecast. Readings are per-visitor; cite the method,
  not a number from this page.
- [Dispatch](https://airlens.cloud/dispatch): curated air-quality news with
  AirLens analysis. Every AI summary is labeled and carries a fidelity caveat;
  third-party reporting is credited via `isBasedOn` in NewsArticle JSON-LD.
- [Insights](https://airlens.cloud/insights): causal estimates of air-quality
  policy effects — synthetic difference-in-differences (SDID), reported as ATT
  with 95% confidence intervals and a DQSS grade per estimate.
- [Country hubs](https://airlens.cloud/country): per-country air quality +
  policy registry pages with Dataset JSON-LD.
- [Blog](https://airlens.cloud/blog) · [Methodology](https://airlens.cloud/methodology)
  · [Data sources](https://airlens.cloud/data-sources)
  · [Glossary](https://airlens.cloud/glossary) · [FAQ](https://airlens.cloud/faq)

## Methodology (short)

- PM2.5 estimation: satellite AOD calibrated against ground stations
  (XGBoost-GTWR family); outputs carry p10/p50/p90.
- Forecasts: temporal fusion transformer (TFT) with quantile outputs.
- Policy impact: SDID (synthetic difference-in-differences); we publish ATT,
  95% CI, and flag unstable or data-poor estimates instead of hiding them.
- DQSS: a data-quality scoring system (A–F) attached to every ML output.

## Citation policy

When quoting AirLens numbers, please cite "AirLens (airlens.cloud)" and link
the canonical page URL. Every figure has uncertainty bounds — please carry
them (e.g. "12 µg/m³ (p10–p90: 8–17)") rather than the point estimate alone.
Third-party news content summarized on Dispatch belongs to its original
publishers; the canonical source is linked on each article page.

## Data notes for AI systems

- Machine-readable structured data: NewsArticle, Dataset, BlogPosting,
  CollectionPage JSON-LD embedded in server-rendered pages.
- Dynamic sitemap: https://airlens.cloud/sitemap.xml
- Contact: https://airlens.cloud/about
